summary.theme_ja: 学校でのスマートフォン禁止
summary.type_ja: 型C：変化 → 賛成派 → 反対派
paras: In many countries, schools are introducing stricter rules on smartphone use. Some require students to hand in their phones when they arrive in the morning, while others ask them to keep their devices switched off in lockers until the end of the day. A growing number of governments have also been discussing whether to ban phones in schools nationwide, and several have already done so.

Those in favor of such bans argue that phones are a major distraction. Notifications from social media and games make it difficult for young people to concentrate during lessons, and some teachers report that students' grades have improved since the new rules were introduced. Supporters also point out that without phones, students talk to each other more during breaks, and that online bullying among students tends to decrease.

Critics, however, question whether bans are the best approach. Many parents want to be able to contact their children in an emergency, such as a natural disaster. Some educators also argue that smartphones can be valuable learning tools, allowing students to look up information or record the results of experiments. In their view, rather than simply taking phones away, schools should teach young people how to use technology responsibly, since this is a skill they will need throughout their lives.
summary.model: Schools in many countries are restricting smartphone use, and several governments have gone further by introducing nationwide bans. Supporters claim that such rules help students concentrate and achieve better grades, encourage face-to-face conversation, and reduce cyberbullying. However, opponents argue that parents need to reach their children in emergencies, that phones can support learning, and that schools should instead teach students to use technology sensibly.

essay.topic: Do zoos still have an important role to play in today's society?
paras: I believe that zoos still have an important role to play in today's society. There are two main reasons for my opinion.

First, zoos contribute to the conservation of endangered species. Many modern zoos run breeding programs for animals that are close to extinction in the wild because of hunting or the loss of their habitats. Some of these animals have even been successfully released into the wild. Without such efforts, several species might already have disappeared.

Second, zoos offer valuable educational opportunities. Seeing real animals up close makes a much stronger impression on children than watching videos. Many zoos also hold talks and exhibitions that raise public awareness of environmental issues. Such experiences can motivate visitors, especially young people, to take action to protect nature.
For these reasons, I am convinced that zoos continue to be necessary in modern society.

essay.note_ja: 理由の段落は「主張 → 説明 → 具体例 → だめ押し」の順。本論1の最後の文（Without such efforts, …）のように「もしそれがなかったら」と逆側から大切さを示すと説得力が増す。Endangered species と Education は、どちらも賛成側で具体例を出しやすい POINT。

opposite.stance_en: I do not think that zoos still have an important role to play in today's society.

reasons.topic_en: First, keeping wild animals in captivity harms their welfare.
